facts.fact: Africa Data Centres (Cassava Technologies) announced that ISP ipNX has established a presence in its Lagos data centre to provide colocation and ISP services, so the Lagos facility is operating and hosting a customer; the article gives the announcement date only.
Africa Data Centres (the operator) describes its Lagos data centre as a Tier III data centre; the article gives no certifying body.
